title: Unit Event — Parallel Harmonies — Episode6 Guiding Hands

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need is finally going to start writing its debut song! However, Mr. Shindo has a request: that Saki and Ichika compose it together. The pair are determined to make it a great song, but things don't go so smoothly...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: MEIKO...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wh-What are you doing here...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Honami and Shiho told me that you and Ichika were working on a song together.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I came to see how you were doing...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <And I take it things haven't been going well.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: MEIKO, I...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I see. Which led to you and Ichika butting heads...>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I... I really don't know what we're supposed to do now...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Right...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Why don't you two come take a little break over in SEKAI, Saki?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? But our song...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Yes, that's important. But it's also important to get a breath of fresh air when you're feeling stuck, remember?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<I'll be waiting over there.
Come on over once Ichika returns, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Don't worry, Saki.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I know you don't like arguing with Ichika...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<But you're in a band together.
There are going to be times when you conflict with one another.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <But think about all those other times you bumped heads. You always came to an understanding in the end, right...?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <So, I wouldn't worry too much about this.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You're right...
Thank you for saying that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sorry, Saki, I'm back...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? MEIKO...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Ah, she's back.
Now, shall we?>
bgm_area00001
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, welcome, you two.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
We heard the news.
You're holding a songwriting camp?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: How are things going?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, uhh...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Would you mind if we heard what you've come up with so far?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I'd also like to give what you have a listen.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But we're still...
We're still not happy with what we have...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
A work in progress is just fine.
We want to hear what you two have created.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I see.
So these are the songs you came up with.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes... I came up with the chord progression for the first one, and Saki the melody. The opposite applies to the second...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I think they're both very good.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I agree.
They're wonderful expressions of both of your thoughts and feelings.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: R-Really...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But don't they feel all over the place...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes, there is that...
You can kind of tell what each of you wants out of these songs.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I actually think they're good the way they are.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Y-You do...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But if neither of you is satisfied, then improvements are going to be necessary...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
So, Ichika.
Can you tell me what you envisioned when you came up with your chord progression?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Umm... I was trying to write a cheerful song that would clearly express how I felt.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see. Which explains why yours is very straightforward. Just like you, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Th-Thank you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Next, Saki, how did you arrive on this melody?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I wanted to make it so people can move forward despite any doubts or pain they're feeling...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I see...
That explains why it sounds a little sad.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. The kind touch fits you very well, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: This sort of reminds me of when you girls first got back together...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Exactly...! That's what I was going for...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, we were all separated initially, but we talked through our troubles and managed to find a way to move forward together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And then, Ichi said that she wanted to remind people about who matters most to them...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Which immediately reminded me of us when we first got back together.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I had no idea...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, that's really nice...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then, does that mean you want to make it feel like you've overcome that past pain and are running towards a bright future...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Running towards a bright future...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
We worked super duper hard to become pros!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But my melody doesn't really cover that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: In that case, I might try giving it a slightly happier sound. One that serves as a reminder of our determination.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That should go a lot better with Ichi's chord progression too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I'll be looking forward to listening to it once it's finished.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, I'll see what I can do!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, while we're at it, for the next verse...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Saki seems like she's having so much fun...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(She can't stop coming up with new ideas...
Wait, is this because...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Is that why Miku and the others have been able to give such constructive criticism? Are they being more open-minded about all this?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I thought we were having a nice exchange of ideas, but...)
